messages:
maria: Follow-up from the midnight incident: root cause narrowed to a tokenization+quantization interaction that only triggers under bursty concurrent workloads. We need to convert this into repeatable evals and clear action owners.

alex: Agreed. Proposal: (A) small focused prompt-set that reliably triggers the path, (B) a regression job in the evals pipeline that runs that set, (C) a load profile that reproduces the burst, (D) a chaos drill for fallback loop behavior.

lia: I'll take (A). I'll assemble ~50 prompts that mirror customer traffic (short Q/A, code snippets, mixed unicode). Will include some malformed token cases. Draft samples: 
```
[\"What's the total for invoice #4321?\", \"Fix commit: handle nil cache\", \"Localize: server returned \u201cunexpected token\u201d\"]
```
I'll open a PR with README and tags. Target: Thu EOD.

jonathan: I'll do (C) and (D). For the burst profile I'll configure the runner to 2k RPS with 5s bursts, measure p95/p99 and error rates. Chaos drill plan: force fast fallback from model-heavy to quant-thin variant and monitor scaling/fanout. Will add rollback steps. ETA: Tue runbook + dashboard by next Tue.

maria: Ownership summary: lia -> prompt-set + unit eval pr (DUE Thu), alex -> CI gate + eval pipeline integration (DUE next Fri), jonathan -> burst job + chaos drill + dash panels (DUE next Tue). I'll coordinate triage and mark this incident for monitoring until we get two clean runs.

alex: For CI gate: fail build if quality drop >1.5% on the regression prompts OR if tail latency increases >25% vs baseline. Example config to add to evals orchestrator: 
```
ci_eval_gate: \"token_q_regression_v1\"
quality_drop_pct_threshold: \"1.5\"
p99_latency_ms_threshold: \"220\"
```

lia: Also adding negative tests: truncated-token streams and long-prefix sequences. Will include both in the PR.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-034: \"tokenizer-quant mismatch under high-concurrency\"; action items added INC-2026-034-A1..A5.

maria: Can we tag these prompts so Redwood Optimize sees them as \"safety/regression\" input? Would like optimizer to avoid recommending quant profiles that trigger this.

alex: Yep. I'll add tags and a metadata field so Optimize ingests them. Also add a link back to the postmortem in the evals issue.

lia: GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/issues/433 - I'll link PRs and CI runs there.

sre-bot: Reminder: add the action items to the \"postmortem-actions\" board and set alarms for the nightly regression job.

maria: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. Once we see two clean nightly runs I'll move incident to resolved and close the monitoring loop. :white_check_mark:
